T: One night. Five stops. Plenty of snacks.
D: A cab driver is forced to drive a hitman around Los Angeles for one very long night.
P: Serve the mains when they pull up at the jazz club.
S: Max's long night shifts behind the wheel
Pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews tossed in melted butter, smoked paprika and a little brown sugar, roasted at 160C for 15 minutes, cooled and tipped into paper bags with strips of beef jerky.
the packed Korean nightclub near the end
Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C until shattering, tossed in a glaze of gochujang, soy, honey and garlic, sesame on top.
the jazz club where the owner tells his old story
Devilled eggs with smoked paprika, parmesan cheese straws twisted and baked at 200C for 12 minutes, and warm marinated olives with orange peel and fennel.
M: a stop for food between jobs
Skirt steak marinated in lime, orange, garlic and cumin for 2 hours, seared over very high heat, rested, sliced against the grain, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Max visits his mum in hospital in the middle of it all
Chicken thighs simmered an hour with onion, carrot and celery, shredded back into the strained broth with egg noodles, dill and a squeeze of lemon.
W: the island postcard Max keeps on his sun visor
Blind-baked sweet pastry filled with desiccated coconut, eggs, sugar, butter and coconut milk whisked together, baked at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.
K: Strong drip coffee poured into paper cups with milk and sugar, lids on, ready for the cab's cup holder.

s.note: Max's long night shifts behind the wheel
s.how: Toss 150g pretzels, 150g salted peanuts and 100g cashews with 40g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Roast at 160C for 15 minutes and cool. Tip into paper bags with strips of 100g beef jerky.

s.note: the packed Korean nightclub near the end
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch and fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C until shattering. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and garlic until glossy. Toss and top with sesame.

m.note: a stop for food between jobs
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in lime, orange, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Sear over very high heat, rest and slice against the grain. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander and a jar of salsa roja.

w.note: the island postcard Max keeps on his sun visor
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 200g desiccated coconut, 3 eggs, 150g sugar, 80g melted butter and 200ml coconut milk. Pour in and bake at 170C for 30 minutes until golden and set.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour into paper cups with milk and sugar, put the lids on and set them in the cup holder for the night.
